yourTurn.title: Your turn: {name}
yourTurn.body: It is your turn in round {round}. Your troops await orders.{deadline}
yourTurn.startedBody: The match is under way, and it is your turn in round {round}. Your troops await orders.{deadline}

deadlineSoon.title: Deadline approaching: {name}
deadlineSoon.body: Your turn in “{name}” ends in less than {hours} hours ({deadline}). After that it ends automatically.

remind.title: Reminder: {name}
remind.body: {from} is waiting for your move in “{name}” (round {round}).{deadline}

ended.title: Match ended: {name}
ended.victory: Victory! You have won the match.

matchStarted.body: The match is under way. {name} moves first; you will be told when it is your turn.

invitation.title: Invitation: {name}
invitation.async: {host} invites you to the asynchronous match “{name}” ({seats} seats). Accept the invitation in the lobby.
invitation.live: {host} invites you to the live match “{name}” ({seats} seats). Accept the invitation in the lobby.
